# Enclosing nested factory

Authored lexical-access regression. An instance provider declared inside a
private static generic class returns a carrier of that enclosing class with its
own method formal. The frozen harness checks original receiver/input snapshots,
ignored callback values, partial stores, actual outer and enclosing payload
identity, late casts, null and foreign receivers, and exact failures. Source and
SDK profiles audit every original definition, metadata, Exceptions and helper.
Only authored fixtures execute.
